sources.note: JK Audio Broadcast Host datasheet (copy hosted by a dealer, read as text on 2026-11-12): analog desktop digital hybrid, 7 x 6 x 1.6 in (18 x 15 x 4.2 cm) = 178 x 152 x 41 mm per the plan, 2.2 lb (1 kg), 120-240 VAC power supply included (external, no mains inlet); balanced female XLR send input with a mic / line switch, 3.5 mm mono line input (send 2), balanced male XLR caller output, 3.5 mm stereo output (left = send, right = caller), 3.5 mm headphone jack, RJ11C phone-line and auxiliary-phone jacks, guest-module remote jack. The RJ11 jacks, the remote jack and the DC input have no catalogue connector: drawn on the picture only. Positions are GUESSES (no panel drawing read); the headphone jack is placed on the front.
AVL dealer page (equipment plan source; its fetch answered HTTP 429 in this run).

Mains (review fix, read 2026-11-12 by a research pass): the Broadcast Host user guide says the power jack is only for the supplied regulated 9 VDC supply. No mains inlet is modelled for this device and the entry says so.
